goal: Maintain a canonical inventory of GitHub operational failure incidents from TV/TVC mailbox observations, including workflow failures and Actions capacity/budget exhaustion, and track recurrence/lifecycle through resolution or sandbox-required outcomes.
required_next: observe exact-head deterministic validation when Actions admission is available
bind TVC-owned mailbox transport to the existing sovereign Healer scheduler without exposing credential values to Healer
materialize a bounded real mailbox batch through TVC
backfill workflow failures plus 75/90/100 budget and 90/100 included-minute notifications
connect canonical worker and sandbox lifecycle outcomes
produce failure frequency, recurrence, amplification, capacity-exhaustion and cross-repository propagation metrics
terminal_when: live incremental operational-failure ingestion operates through admitted TV/TVC transport
existing unread GitHub operational failure corpus is inventoried without losing source evidence
100 percent Actions included-minute and budget notices become account-level failure incidents
75 and 90 percent capacity notices remain visible warning/high-risk observations
duplicate notifications map deterministically to canonical incidents
worker unable/impossible-to-repair outcomes produce SANDBOX_REQUIRED incident state
resolved incidents require durable evidence and emit bounded archive plans
systemic correlation metrics are durable and reproducible
no second scheduler, heartbeat, GitHub-token runtime authority or NON-TV/TVC secret/token is introduced
